name: Portal Table Layout
summary: A dense start page in HTML tables: a search box, a link directory, news boxes, banner ads and a blue and orange palette. Web portals of the late 1990s used it to keep a user on one site.

philosophy.core_thesis: One page holds the whole web: pack every service, link and ad into a clear table of boxes.
design_principles: Build the page with nested HTML tables at 760px to 800px wide, centred, with 1px to 2px cell spacing.
Place the logo and a search box with a button in a header row of 60px to 80px, over a tab row of 24px.
Set a link directory in 2 or 3 columns of 11px to 12px text with bold category names.
Give each box a title bar of 18px to 22px in a light blue band (#99CCFF) with bold dark blue text.
Add a banner of 468px by 60px at the top and a skyscraper of 120px by 600px on the right.
Set all links in blue (#0000CC) with underline, and show the visited links in purple.
Use spacer images and a 1px line in grey (#999999) to hold the cell widths.
anti_patterns: One focal image and a short text
Light, thin type at large sizes

layout.grid_mechanics: A fixed table of 760px to 800px with 2 to 3 columns of 150px, 300px and 150px; cell spacing 2px and cell padding 4px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 10% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 2, 4 and 8px.
layout.alignment_rules: Text flush left in boxes; the logo and the search centred in the header.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular table cells with a 0px radius and a 1px line; boxes stack with a 4px gap.

font_pairings.note: Arimo is an open look-alike of Arial and Helvetica, the portal text face.
A neutral open face that stands in for Verdana at 11px.
A clean display over small text.

hierarchy_rules: Use 11px to 12px for link lists and 14px bold for box titles.
Use 24px bold for the logo word only.
Use bold for category names and plain text for items.
Use blue for links and red for 'new' tags.

color.palette_structure: White ground, one blue, one orange accent and a pale blue band for box titles.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on white is 17:1; link blue on white is 11:1; dark blue on pale blue is 7:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour in cells; a thin 1px line and a pale band for headers; no gradient or at most a 2-stop button.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; one 1px outset on buttons and no drop shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A printed directory page: flat boxes and lines on a white sheet.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px solid grey line around each box; a 1px outset on buttons.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Small 16px GIF icons for mail, news and weather; tab shapes with square corners.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Banner ads, a small photo for the lead story and a text logo; almost no decoration.

motion.transition_physics: Pages load by hard cut; the only motion is a rotating banner that swaps every 10s with no easing.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover keeps the underline and turns a link to red (#CC0000); the pressed button shows a 1px inset.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels in control: everything is on one page, and every box has a purpose.

use_cases: directory and news pages in a retro style
avoid_when: The page needs a single clear action.
The device is a phone and the reading is quick.
The brand needs a premium, calm tone.

modifiers.how: Replace the blue table with a tiled background, GIFs and a counter.
Round the boxes, add 2-stop gradient titles and a reflection under the logo.
Keep the search box and remove the link wall and the ads.

pack.why: Small square marks match the 16px GIF icons of a portal.

ground.why: The ground is white with thin grey rules between table cells.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none border border-[#999999] bg-[#99CCFF] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#003399]
